review_notes: Reviewed all declarations and proofs in DualCert.lean, along with the DualCertificate and additiveFunction definitions in LeanPool/KaltonRoberts/Defs.lean and Mathlib's Set.indicator and Finsupp.indicator APIs. Finset.indicator' is a named characteristic-function specialization used throughout the proof; the available generic indicator operations do not establish a practical consolidation cost under this rubric. No other declaration in the file appears to introduce an avoidable competing version of a Mathlib, Batteries, or Lean-core concept.
